description: Source code for wrt350nv2-builder, a program that creates firmware images for Linksys WRT350N v2 routers, including parsing parameter files, constructing binary images, and packaging into zip and img formats.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling command-line arguments, file processing, and orchestrating the creation of firmware images.

methods.name: parse_par_file
methods.description: Parses the parameter file to extract firmware component details and their file paths.

methods.name: create_bin_file
methods.description: Creates a binary firmware image in memory based on parsed data and static content.

methods.name: create_zip_file
methods.description: Packages the binary image into a zip archive.

methods.name: create_img_file
methods.description: Creates a final firmware image file combining header, zip archive, and checksum.

methods.name: lprintf
methods.description: Logging function that outputs messages based on verbosity level.
